__comment: The backing plate of a panel label: 7 x 2 pixels, a quarter of a pixel proud. Drawn from a white material because the renderer tints it with the label's own plate colour; the grey it used to be is now PanelLabel.DEFAULT_PLATE_COLOUR. Authored plate-down in the SurfaceMount frame and kept in step with PanelLabel.PLATE, which is what the label's footprint and hitbox come from.
